title: Kagamine Len — Even Though She's My Partner〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're about to go practice, right? I wanna go too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aren't we supposed to practice on our own today?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I know, but...!
There's this part I want to work on with you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I have stuff that I need to work on too, you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you have to work on it all by yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Today? Kind of...
More importantly, is something bothering you, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: M-Me?! N-No, there's really only this part that I want to work on with you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So when we do practice together, promise that we'll focus on that...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I promise!
See you later...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were so good just now too, Kohane! You shined throughout that entire song!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so jealous of you, An!
I wish I could sing with Kohane as her partner!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's not what I meant, but sure...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I couldn't focus at all during practice.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So what happened?
Are you having another fight?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is what Rin said about wanting to sing with Kohane bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm her partner, aren't I?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I even asked her just a little while ago to practice with me, but she told me that she wanted to practice alone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If one partner says they want to sing together, shouldn't the other one grant their wish?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len, please try not to spill your cream soda...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here, have some ice cream and try to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, wait, I didn't mean you can have all of it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Anyway, just try to calm down.
I really don't think Rin meant anything by what she said.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So you do understand...?
If that's the case, all you need to do is make up your mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You said that you weren't trying to puff your chest out that time, but it's clear that Rin means a lot to you, Len. Enough to make you feel the way you do now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, I don't see anything wrong with what you did. Do you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, I looked like an idiot... It was so embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You want to be the best partner you can, right? Are you going to let something like that get in your way?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm gonna try to be the best partner Rin's ever had!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Kohane became an incredible singer after practicing really hard, so I'm gonna do that too! Can you help me with that, Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, but it won't be easy.
